This careful alchemy marks the birth of Bidriware, the striking, sooty-black metalcraft born in Bidar. Onto this dark base, artisans engrave intricate motifs using fine grooving chisels, then inlay the patterns with pure silver, creating a striking contrast. It calls for earth found only in the shadowed, silent corners of Bidar Fort, where time lingers and whispers. The artisans test the soil on their tongues, searching for the perfect mineral balance, known only by taste, passed down through generations. Only then is it worthy to give Bidri its signature hue."],"extra":["Care Tips: Smear some oil on the item and polish with a soft cloth.","GI. No – 20/2005.
